       SUM(v.dosetotal) as total_doses, c.volliters

LEFT JOIN vaccinedetails v ON c.containregistry = v.containvac
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
GROUP BY c.containregistry, c.containflag, c.volliters

args.question: Can you clarify how Storage Efficiency Ratio (SER) and Temperature Stability Score (TSS) are calculated? What specific columns or formulas should I use?

result: The Storage Efficiency Ratio (SER) is calculated using the formula `(vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters`, provided that `c.volliters` is not null and greater than 0, and `vd.vialtally` is not null. Otherwise, it defaults to 0. The Temperature Stability Score (TSS) is calculated as `(1.0 - COALESCE(lsd.tempdevcount, 0) / 100.0) * (1.0 - COALESCE(lsd.critevents, 0) / 10.0) * COALESCE(lsd.tempstabidx, 1.0)`, and it will be null if there is no corresponding sensor data.

-- Test SER calculation
SELECT c.containregistry, c.containflag, vd.vialtally, c.volliters, 
       (vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters as ser
FROM container c
JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON c.containregistry = vd.containvac
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
ORDER BY ser DESC LIMIT 20;

-- Try with dosetotal / volliters
SELECT c.containregistry, c.containflag, vd.dosetotal, c.volliters, 
       (vd.dosetotal * 1.0) / c.volliters as ser2
FROM container c
JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON c.containregistry = vd.containvac
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
ORDER BY ser2 DESC LIMIT 20;

-- Check how many containers have SER > 0.8 using the given formula
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_with_ser_gt_08
FROM container c
JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON c.containregistry = vd.containvac
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
  AND c.volliters IS NOT NULL 
  AND c.volliters > 0
  AND vd.vialtally IS NOT NULL
  AND (vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters > 0.8;

-- Check TSS calculation for active containers
SELECT c.containregistry, 
       (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.tempdevcount, 0) / 100.0) * 
       (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.critevents, 0) / 10.0) * 
       COALESCE(sd.tempstabidx, 1.0) as tss
FROM container c
LEFT JOIN sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
ORDER BY tss DESC LIMIT 30;

-- Check how many active containers have TSS > 0.9
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_with_tss_gt_09
FROM container c
LEFT JOIN sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
  AND (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.tempdevcount, 0) / 100.0) * 
      (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.critevents, 0) / 10.0) * 
      COALESCE(sd.tempstabidx, 1.0) > 0.9;

-- Show all containers meeting both criteria
SELECT c.containregistry, c.containflag,
       (vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters as ser,
       (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.tempdevcount, 0) / 100.0) * 
       (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.critevents, 0) / 10.0) * 
       COALESCE(sd.tempstabidx, 1.0) as tss
FROM container c
JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON c.containregistry = vd.containvac
LEFT JOIN sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
  AND c.volliters IS NOT NULL AND c.volliters > 0
  AND vd.vialtally IS NOT NULL
  AND (vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters > 0.8
  AND (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.tempdevcount, 0) / 100.0) * 
      (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.critevents, 0) / 10.0) * 
      COALESCE(sd.tempstabidx, 1.0) > 0.9;

UPDATE container
SET containflag = 'Active-Efficient'
WHERE containregistry IN (
    SELECT c.containregistry
    FROM container c
    JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON c.containregistry = vd.containvac
    LEFT JOIN sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    WHERE c.containflag = 'Active'
      AND c.volliters IS NOT NULL AND c.volliters > 0
      AND vd.vialtally IS NOT NULL
      AND (vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters > 0.8

          (1.0 - COALESCE(sd.critevents, 0) / 10.0) * 
          COALESCE(sd.tempstabidx, 1.0) > 0.9
);
